decisions.reason: Despite its greater distance from the core range, it is a multi-model line for maritime users, so the firm can justify past investment and niche-market delays and is therefore likely to continue it.
This product line fits the firm's industrial lighting business and LED direction, has visible website commitment and follow-on development, and so management is very likely to persist with it.
As a relaunch of an already popular close-to-core product, it carries reputational commitment and enough fit with the existing offer that management would be inclined to give it more time.
Office luminaires are central to the firm's established customer base and strategic move toward efficient professional LED lighting, which makes withdrawal relatively unlikely.
A premium multi-model pendant line represents meaningful development investment in a core segment, so an escalation-prone management would likely retain it unless results became clearly untenable.
